description: Unlockable alternate battle-voice packs for customizable characters: one row per character/category/variant, with the sample cues used for shop and customization preview.

Id.technical: FName primary key. Item rows for EGameItemType::CustomVoice reference this Id through Item.VariableId; tiles, shop preview and game-save validation resolve the row by that value, and the selected row's Id is written back into the customization tile settings. Export spells it ID.

Id_Character.simple: Character that owns this voice pack.
Id_Character.technical: FName into CharacterDataTable. It is the first filter in CollectVoiceSamples, the customization tile filter, save-data validation and item description/icon logic. The icon path constructs "<Id_Character>_00" to find the CharacterImage row; the description path resolves the character to return its Id.

Category.simple: Which attack voice set is customized: normal or cursed-energy attack.
Category.technical: EGameCustomVoiceCategory (None default, NormalAttack, CursedEnergyAttack, Invalid). It partitions tile views (NormalAttack/CursedEnergyAttack), chooses which sample map PreviewVoice consults, is combined with IndexType to tint the item icon background, and is checked against hard-coded category values 1/2 in save validation. The exported 162 rows split evenly across the two real categories.

IndexType.simple: Variant slot inside the category: Default, TypeA or TypeB.
IndexType.technical: EGameCustomVoiceIndexType (None default, Default, TypeA, TypeB, Invalid). CollectVoiceSamples precreates a map entry for Default/TypeA/TypeB and appends this row's samples under its IndexType key. The same enum is mapped through GUnknownByteIntMap0 (None/Default=0, TypeA=1, TypeB=2) to the saved CharacterIntPair First/Second value, and selects the icon tint. Rows with None/Invalid would not be appended to the three sample buckets.

Id_Voice_Sample.simple: Voice row IDs used to audition this pack.
Id_Voice_Sample.technical: TArray<FName> into VoiceDataTable. Collection appends samples from every row matching CharacterId+Category+IndexType and removes None entries. PreviewVoice picks Samples[SampleIndex] when valid (index 0 otherwise), resolves its Voice row, and, only if that row's cue sheet is already loaded, plays it via PlaySystemVoice and advances SampleIndex by 1. It is a preview list, not the in-battle rule for which line plays.

notes: Loaded as a 'DataTable' primary asset named CharacterCustomVoiceDataTable into DTM.CharacterCustomVoiceDataTables (+0x560).

The row itself is a catalog entry; ownership is checked indirectly through ItemDataTable rows whose VariableId equals this row's Id. Save values are stored as an int pair (normal attack variant in First, cursed-energy variant in Second) and are reset to 0 if the matching row is missing or its item is not owned.
Category/IndexType are also visual metadata: GameItemIconWidget maps their combination to a background color from CustomVoiceBackgroundColor and uses a separate category sprite.
The exported table contains 27 characters x 2 categories x 3 variants in the available content; this is not proof of all retail rows or Blueprint consumers.
Source is reconstructed from retail code; retail RVAs are recorded in source comments.

usages.detail: Collects all voice rows and builds the character/category/variant sample maps.
PreviewVoice resolves a row and plays its next VoiceDataTable sample.
Persists selected IndexType into the user's customization int pairs.
Restores tile settings by matching character, category and saved variant.
Validates saved voice selections against table rows and owned items.
Resolves an item's voice row to display its character.
Uses the row's character, category and variant for icon and background color.
Shop preview resolves rows and returns their sample lists.
